title: Run
description: Definitions the client protocol's run messages share: run ids, what perform is asked to run, a run's summary as status and logs report it, and one recorded run event.

runId.title: Run id
runId.description: A UUID in canonical lowercase form, minted by perform.

runRef.title: Run reference
runRef.description: A run's full id, or a prefix of at least 8 hex digits that matches exactly one run.

actorName.title: Actor name
actorName.description: The actor's name. It becomes the agent's id in lineage.

runnerName.title: Runner name
runnerName.description: A runner troupe knows by name. A request never carries a command line.

theatrePath.title: Theatre-relative path
theatrePath.description: A path relative to the theatre's root, with / separators. Never a host path, a drive, or a path that leaves the theatre with ..

effectCheck.title: Effect check
effectCheck.description: How troupe checks, after a run, that it did what it was for. There is no default: none must be said explicitly.

paths.description: Each file must exist after the run, and differ from before it.

state.title: State
state.description: Derived, never recorded: ended (its end is recorded), running (its perform is alive in this clone), interrupted (its perform has gone without recording an end), or unfinished-elsewhere (it was started in another clone, so this clone can't tell).

reported.description: The runner's name and version from its init event, the run's first reported event. Absent: it sent none.

workspace.description: Where the run works: its own worktree, or the theatre. A worktree's clones are absent until it is made.

outcome.description: How the run ended. Present exactly when state is ended.

error.description: Why the run didn't succeed. Absent: the outcome has no error, or the run hasn't ended.

events.description: How many run events are recorded.

endedAt.description: When the run's end was recorded. Present exactly when state is ended.

transcript.description: The transcript's artifact reference. Absent: the run hasn't ended, or its runner never started.

stderr.description: The artifact reference of the runner's standard error. Absent: the run hasn't ended, or its runner never started.

recording.description: The first seq that wasn't recorded, and why. Absent: recording the run's events didn't fail.

changes.description: What a worktree run changed, and what has been done with it. Present exactly when the workspace is a worktree.

changes.title: A run's changes
changes.description: A worktree run's changes. state: pending (captured, not yet accepted or discarded), accepted, discarded, none (the run changed nothing) or uncaptured (the run was interrupted, or capturing failed). The worktree is kept until the changes are accepted or discarded.

diff.description: The diff's artifact reference. Present exactly when the run's end recorded one.

added.description: How many files the diff adds. Absent: nothing was captured.

modified.description: How many files the diff modifies. Absent: nothing was captured.

deleted.description: How many files the diff deletes. Absent: nothing was captured.

leftOut.description: How many changed paths under .troupe/ were left out of the diff. Absent: nothing was captured.

shared.description: What changed in the repository's shared state during the run, which discarding doesn't undo. Absent: nothing did, or nothing was captured.

error.description: Why the changes couldn't be captured. Absent: they were, or the run was interrupted.

settledAt.description: When they were accepted or discarded. Present exactly when state is accepted or discarded.

worktree.description: The worktree, relative to the theatre, while it is kept. Absent once the changes are accepted or discarded.

loggedEvent.title: Logged run event
loggedEvent.description: One run event as it was recorded: the runner's event, or troupe's oversized stand-in for it, and when troupe recorded it.
